description: This file contains classes for training and using image classification models with TensorFlow/Keras, supporting multiple architectures like MobileNetV2, ResNet50, InceptionV3, and DenseNet121. It includes classes for training models ('ClassificationModelTrainer') and for classifying images with custom models ('CustomImageClassification').

classes.name: ClassificationModelTrainer
classes.description: A class for training image classification models with support for multiple architectures and dataset management.

classes.name: CustomImageClassification
classes.description: A class for loading trained models and performing image classification with support for multiple architectures.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsSqueezeNet
methods.description: Raises an error indicating SqueezeNet is no longer supported.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsMobileNetV2
methods.description: Sets the model type to MobileNetV2 for training or classification.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsResNet50
methods.description: Sets the model type to ResNet50.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsDenseNet121
methods.description: Sets the model type to DenseNet121.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsInceptionV3
methods.description: Sets the model type to InceptionV3.

methods.name: setDataDirectory
methods.description: Configures dataset directories for training, testing, models, and JSON labels.

methods.name: lr_schedule
methods.description: Defines the learning rate schedule based on epoch number.

methods.name: trainModel
methods.description: Starts training the model with specified parameters, including dataset, epochs, and architecture.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the custom trained model.

methods.name: setJsonPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the JSON file containing class labels.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model structure and weights for classification, supporting different architectures.

methods.name: loadFullModel
methods.description: Loads a full Keras model from a file, without architecture restrictions.

methods.name: getModels
methods.description: Returns the internal list of loaded models.

methods.name: classifyImage
methods.description: Classifies an input image (file, array, or stream) and returns top predictions with probabilities.
